title: One broken Make workflow? $49 fixed repair after a scope check
text: If your Make workflow stops with an error, creates duplicate spreadsheet rows, or puts dates in the wrong format, I can help investigate one clearly defined problem. The $49 USD pilot covers one agreed repair in an existing scenario, a before/after test, and short instructions explaining the change. Target delivery is two business days after we confirm the scope and funding. New integrations, paid subscriptions, and complete rebuilds are quoted separately. I use AI-assisted debugging and testing. This is a new service; I am not claiming client results or certifications I have not earned. Reply with the apps involved, what should happen, what happens instead, and a redacted error message. Please do not post passwords, access tokens, customer records, or other private information. I will confirm whether the issue fits the pilot before we agree to any work.
triage_reason: Offering a paid fixed repair service for Make workflows.

title: US-Based Bubble Developer Needed – Take Over Existing Marketplace Build – Paid P
text: I’m looking for an experienced US-based Bubble developer to take over development of an existing web app and get it through a functional beta launch. The platform is PeerRate, a two-sided peer-to-peer marketplace with additional functionality around transactions, user reputation, negotiated offers/terms and payments. I don’t want to publicly post the entire business model, but I have a detailed functional specification that I can share with the developer I select. The app is already in rough-draft form in Bubble. The basic UI, user accounts, marketplace, listings, dashboards and branding have been started. I’m not looking for someone to simply design pages — I need someone who understands Bubble well enough to build the actual backend functionality and finish the application. Current scope includes buyer/seller accounts, listings, offers and counteroffers, transaction states, buyer/seller dashboards, reputation/rating logic, Stripe/Stripe Connect integration, automated payment workflows, contextual messaging, notifications, admin controls, privacy rules, fulfillment/disputes, responsive design and final beta testing. I already know how I want the platform to function and have documented it in detail. I need someone who can take that direction, build it correctly, and work through the technical decisions with me where necessary. I’m specifically looking for someone who is: US-based Experienced with Bubble beyond basic website development Comfortable taking over an existing Bubble project Experienced with backend workflows and APIs Ideally experienced with Stripe Connect/marketplace payments Able to show Bubble applications they personally built Communicative and available for calls/screenshares This is paid work and I’m ready to get started. I’m open to hourly or milestone-based arrangements, but I want to hire someone who can actually take ownership of the development process and potentially stay involved as PeerRate grows. The Bubble app, Stripe account, domain and all project assets will remain under my ownership. Developer access will be provided through the appropriate collaborator permissions. If interested, DM me your location/time zone, Bubble experience, examples of applications you’ve built, experience with Stripe/marketplace applications, rate, and current availability.
triage_reason: Looking to hire a Bubble developer to take over marketplace app.
